Work in /opt/nxeon (Next.js/TS, LIVE prod tree). You OWN the referral/affiliate feature area. Do NOT edit the sidebar/nav (report your new routes; I wire nav), chrome, mail, chat, or analytics.

Nxeon-board card cmsuki1la "KOL/Agency Referral System": Nxeon wants to partner with agencies/content creators (KOLs) who build websites for clients; those clients also need hosting. The agency refers the customer and earns a LIFETIME percentage on EVERY service that referred customer ever buys or renews — the agency stays permanently attached to that customer.

First study the EXISTING affiliate/referral system (there is one — lib/affiliate*, referral code on User `referralCode`/`referredById`, AffiliatePayout model, /dashboard/affiliate, /affiliate, coupons). Determine what's already there vs what "lifetime per-customer attribution on all future services + renewals" needs. Then implement:
1. Schema (ADDITIVE only — new models/fields, never alter existing): a durable link between a referred Customer and their referring agency/KOL partner, a commission rate per partner, and a commission ledger that accrues on every qualifying charge (initial order AND renewals, across all products) for the life of the customer.
2. Hook commission accrual into the billing/charge path (where orders + renewals are recorded — e.g. Invoice creation / fulfil-checkout / renewal jobs) so a commission entry is created for the attached partner on each qualifying charge. Idempotent; never double-accrue.
3. A partner-facing view (their attached customers + accrued/lifetime commission) and an admin view to manage partners/rates and see payouts. New routes (report them for nav wiring).

Keep it consistent with the existing affiliate model; extend it rather than forking a parallel system if that's cleaner. Be explicit in your report about what you reused vs added.

Constraints: NO `npm run build`/`next build` — `npx tsc --noEmit` only. Prisma changes ADDITIVE only (list new models/fields so I can db push). Report: existing-vs-new, the accrual hook points (file:line), new routes, open design questions for the owner, tsc result.

## Report: KOL/Agency Referral System (card cmsuki1la)

### Existing system (studied) vs. what was needed
The repo already has **two** referral concepts, both reused/left untouched:
- **Peer referral**: `User.referralCode`/`referredById` + `lib/actions-growth.ts:maybeRewardReferral` — pays a **one-time** wallet bonus to a customer who refers a friend, on their first paid action.
- **Affiliate cash-out**: `AffiliatePayout` model + `lib/affiliate.ts`/`lib/actions-affiliate.ts` + `/dashboard/affiliate` + `/admin/affiliate` — converts wallet referral credit into payout requests.

Neither does **lifetime, per-customer, per-charge attribution across all products**. That is genuinely new, so I **extended additively** (new `Partner*` models, new lib, new routes) rather than forking the affiliate flow. I deliberately did **not** reuse the `Agency*` models — those are the unrelated Sitewave web-design product.

**Reused**: `Invoice`/`invoiceCreateData` as the qualifying-charge signal; `formatMoney`/`currentCurrency`, `PageHeader`/`Badge`/`timeAgo`/`PortalHero` primitives; `requireArea("billing")`/`requireUser`; the register `?ref=` capture; the admin/customer page layout conventions; `auditLog`.

### 1. Schema — ADDITIVE only (`prisma/schema.prisma`) — run `db push`
New models: **`ReferralPartner`** (agency/KOL: `code` unique, `commissionRatePct`, `status`, optional `userId` login link), **`PartnerCustomer`** (durable attachment; `customerId @unique` = one partner per customer for life), **`PartnerCommission`** (ledger; `invoiceId @unique` = the idempotency guard; snapshots `baseCents`/`ratePct`/`amountCents`, `kind`, `status`).
New **relation-only back-references** (no new columns on existing tables): `User.referralPartner`, `User.partnerAttachment`, `User.partnerCommissions`; `Invoice.partnerCommission`.

### 2. Accrual hooks (idempotent via unique `invoiceId`; never double-accrue)
Core engine `lib/partner-commission.ts` (`accrueCommissionForInvoice` — commission on **net = amount − tax**, excludes top-ups & refunds; `reconcilePartnerCommissions` sweep; `attachCustomerToPartnerByCode`). Hook points:
- `lib/order.ts:903` — after `placeOrder` commits (initial order), inline.
- `lib/actions.ts:1075` — after `renewNow` commits (manual renewal), inline.
- `worker/index.ts:1451` — `reconcilePartnerCommissions()` in the 10-min billing loop, **after** `billingSweep`+`productRenewalSweep`. This is the durable backstop covering **every** charge path (auto-renewals, upgrades, NxCloud, domains, email/hosting/volumes) without touching their transaction bodies.
- `lib/actions.ts:224` — register: `attachCustomerToPartnerByCode` (a `?ref=` code that matches a partner attaches the new customer for life).

### 3. New routes (for you to wire into nav)
- **`/dashboard/partner`** — partner-facing portal (their link/code, attached customers, per-customer + accrued/lifetime/paid commission). Shows an explainer to non-partners.
- **`/admin/partners`** — admin list, totals, create-partner form.
- **`/admin/partners/[id]`** — admin detail: edit rate/pause, attach/detach customers, commission ledger, "mark accrued paid" settlement.

### Open design questions for you
- **Partner payout mechanism**: I made settlement **off-wallet** (admin marks ACCRUED→PAID, no wallet movement) since agencies are usually paid by bank transfer — unlike the affiliate wallet cash-out. Confirm that's the intended model.
- **Commission base**: net (pre-tax). Should free/100%-promo first months (which create no invoice or a $0 one) ever earn commission? Currently no (no positive invoice = no accrual).
- **Retroactive attach**: attaching an existing customer only earns commission on **future** charges (the sweep is bounded to ~45 days and only accrues invoices with no existing row). Want backfill of historical invoices on attach?
- **Code namespace overlap**: a `?ref=` code could in theory match both a user referral code and a partner code; both programs would then apply independently. Fine, but flagging it.
- **RBAC/nav**: `/admin/partners` isn't in `HREF_AREA` (`lib/rbac.ts`), so it defaults to ADMIN-only for nav visibility; the existing `/admin/affiliate` is mapped to `"billing"`. Add `/admin/partners` → `"billing"` there if you want BILLING-role staff to see it (pages already self-guard with `requireArea("billing")`).
